testcase.name: [CACHE-05] Settings shows one concise usage card with file sizes, budget and explicitly page-local counters

[CACHE-05] closing/switching Settings ignores stale reads and unavailable storage is not reported as an empty cache
[CACHE-05] cache byte formatting is compact at zero, KB, MB and GB
[CACHE-01] actual image bytes survive closing/reopening the database without expiry
[CACHE-01] one network miss produces a reusable payload; subsequent navigation-style loads make no request
[CACHE-02] LRU byte pressure removes oldest bytes, touches protect recent images and replacements do not inflate accounting
[CACHE-02] concurrent tab-style writers preserve atomic byte/count totals
[CACHE-03] clear invalidates in-flight generations and never accepts stale writes
[CACHE-03] unavailable storage and permission/network failures fall back without breaking loading
[CACHE-02] a quota failure prunes old data and retries once, then disables writes if quota remains exhausted
[CACHE-03] cancellation ignores late transport callbacks and cache reads; unsafe/unknown destinations do not use privileged requests
[CACHE-01] media pool stores only decoded successes and reads data URLs without re-training the host
[CACHE-03] corrupted cached bytes are invalidated and a forced retry bypasses saved images
[CACHE-03] disabling persistence skips cache transport and blocked image policy preserves native loading
[CACHE-03] a transport failure switches that host to native loading for the rest of the page
[CACHE-02] replacement writes at capacity keep accurate size/counts and disabled writes leave old files readable
[CACHE-03] an empty older database upgrades to a complete usable cache
[CACHE-03] privileged image transport upgrades legacy HTTP URLs and never accepts a plaintext final response
[CACHE-03] duplicate transport completion/error callbacks deliver one result and abort errors stay contained
[CACHE-01] a missing small variant does not disable caching the successful original fallback
[CACHE-03] document navigation aborts manager transfers while BFCache keeps the existing page usable
[CACHE-01] successful variant hints flush before navigation instead of waiting for the debounce

[CACHE-04] a large file labeled as a thumbnail does not receive small-thumbnail protection

[CACHE-04] shrinking the cache removes previews first and thumbnails only as the last resort

[CACHE-05] usage summary counts actual thumbnail and preview files/bytes without reading image Blobs
[CACHE-05] replacements, role changes, pruning, removal and clear keep summary counters consistent
